title: Oven Roasted Slovakian Beef Dumplings
description: Hearty roasted dumplings filled with beef and wrapped in corn husks, served in a savory broth made with beef stock cubes and dashi extract.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the ground beef, chopped onion, minced garlic, beaten egg, salt, and black pepper, and mix until just combined.
Lay a corn husk flat on a work surface and place a tablespoon of the beef mixture in the center of the husk.
Fold the sides of the husk over the filling and roll the dumpling up, starting from the wide end.
Repeat with the remaining corn husks and beef mixture.
Place the dumplings in a single layer in a large baking dish and add the beef stock cubes and dashi extract.
Pour in enough water to cover the dumplings and bring to a boil on the stovetop.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and transfer to the preheated oven.
Roast for 25 minutes, then remove the foil and continue roasting for an additional 10 minutes.
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F (no longer pink in the middle) before serving.
